tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open positions on the public careers pages. All filters are optional and combined with AND. Returns title, employer, location, hours, salary if published, and links to the job page and the 60-second application (no CV needed).

tools.name: get_employer
tools.description: Everything on one careers page as schema.org JSON-LD: the employer, the page and all open positions. Use employer_slug from search_jobs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One position as schema.org JobPosting with tasks, requirements, benefits and the application link. Use employer_slug and job_id from search_jobs.
